metadata.attribution: Sadrži informacije MZOM-a i Državne geodetske uprave u skladu s Otvorenom dozvolom. DGU adrese: 1. 11. 2026. Izmjena: ručno povezivanje s vrtićima i pretvorba EPSG:3035 u EPSG:4326.
metadata.transformation: EPSG:3035 GML axis order northing/easting to EPSG:4326 longitude/latitude using pyproj; address points, not surveyed kindergarten entrances.

scope: Four reviewed physical facilities; retains existing institutions and their registered seats. No automatic importer included.
